What changed in patch 26.22

Released November 4, 2026. The changes that matter for Summoner's Rift, explained in plain words. Our builds and tier list are already updated for this patch. Full details in the official patch notes.

The big picture

  • Mel got a midscope update: her W no longer reflects spells. It now destroys enemy projectiles in an area and hits back, and her power moves from early game to late game.
  • Locke, Yasuo and Thresh were nerfed. Locke and Yasuo were among the most-banned champions, and Thresh was the top support for high-level players.
  • Ten champions got buffs, including Corki, Rumble, Smolder, Viktor, Naafiri and Kayle, plus jungle buffs for Shen and Maokai.
  • Doran's Bow lost 1 attack damage, so marksmen have more reason to start Doran's Blade.
  • Overlord's Bloodmail gives more flat attack damage but a bit less from its missing-health passive, a buff for most juggernauts.
  • Teamfight Tactics moves to its own client from November 4, so this patch is a bigger download than usual.

Champions with guides on this site

Locke

Nerfed

Less early damage, so his lane bullying is weaker.

  • Q stack bonus damage: 18/26/34/42/50 → 15/22/29/36/43
  • Q maximum stack damage: 75.6/109.2/142.8/176.4/210 → 63/92.4/121.8/151.2/180.6
  • W duration: 6s → 5s

Smolder

Buffed

His W explosion hits harder at every rank, helping both crit and caster builds.

  • W explosion damage: 10/35/60/85/110 → 25/50/75/100/125 (+50% bonus AD) (+80% AP)

Viktor

Buffed

A bit tankier and more ultimate damage, so he scales better into late game.

  • Health growth: 100/level → 105/level
  • R conjure damage AP ratio: 50% → 60%

Yasuo

Nerfed

His Q scales a little less with attack damage, so crit builds hit slightly softer.

  • Q AD ratio: 105% total AD → 100% total AD

Other champions

Aurelion Sol

Buffed

Maxing E second is now a real option, so his black hole hurts more over time.

  • E total magic damage: 50/75/100/125/150 (+60% AP) → 50/80/110/140/170 (+60/65/70/75/80% AP) over 5s

Corki

Buffed

His rockets hit harder, so his poke and mid-game damage go up.

  • R damage: 90/170/250 (+85% bonus AD) → 100/190/280 (+90% bonus AD)
  • R Big One damage: 180/340/500 (+170% bonus AD) → 200/380/560 (+180% bonus AD)

Kayle

Buffed

Shorter cooldowns help her survive and trade in the early laning phase.

  • Q cooldown: 12/11/10/9/8s → 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s
  • R cooldown: 160/120/80s → 140/110/80s

Maokai

Buffed

His Q does more health-based damage, which mainly helps him in top lane and jungle.

  • Q target max health damage: 2/2.5/3/3.5/4% → 2.5/3/3.5/4/4.5%

Mel

Reworked

Weaker early but stronger late, and her W now blocks projectiles in an area and hits back instead of reflecting them.

All 23 changes
  • Health: 640 + 99/level → 590 + 107/level
  • Mana: 480 + 28/level → 455 + 38/level
  • Armor growth: +5.2/level → +5.4/level
  • Attack damage: 54 + 3.3/level → 52 + 3.3/level
  • Attack speed growth: 2.5%/level → 2.75%/level
  • Passive bonus damage per bolt: 8-30 (+4% AP) → 4-30 (+4% AP)
  • Passive first stack damage vs minions: 50% less → 45% less
  • Q first hit damage: 60/85/110/135/160 (+55% AP) → 60 (+25% AP)
  • Q multi-hit damage: 5/7/9/11/13 (+5% AP) → 5/10/15/20/25 (+8% AP)
  • Q total damage: 85-277 (+80-100% AP) → 85-285 (+65-97% AP)
  • Q new: refunds 0.5-1.0s cooldown (by level) when it hits an enemy champion
  • Q mana cost: 70/75/80/85/90 → 60/65/70/75/80
  • Q missile speed: 3800 → 3200
  • W reworked: 400-unit nova that destroys enemy projectiles and shields, then retaliates
  • W retaliation damage: 35/40/45/50/55 (+10% AP), then 5/10/15/20/25 (+5% AP) on repeat hits, up to 7 per enemy
  • W shield: 80/110/140/170/200 (+70% AP) for 2s
  • W move speed: 10-30% (by level) for 2s
  • W mana cost: 100/80/60/40/0
  • W cooldown: 30/28.5/27/25.5/24s
  • E root duration: 1.5s → 0.8-1.6 / 0.85-1.75 / 0.9-1.9 / 0.95-2.05 / 1.0-2.2s (longer with distance)
  • E slow: 30% → 20/25/30/35/40%
  • E mana cost: 50/60/70/80/90 → 40/50/60/70/80
  • R cooldown: 120/100/80s → 120/90/60s

Naafiri

Buffed

More healing and damage, aimed mostly at making her mid lane viable again.

  • Q heal: 45/60/75/90/105 (+40% bonus AD) → 55/70/85/100/115 (+45% bonus AD)
  • W bonus attack damage: 20% → 22%

Rumble

Buffed

His ultimate deals more damage, which makes his teamfights stronger.

  • R damage per second AP ratio: 35% → 40%
  • R maximum damage AP ratio: 175% → 200%

Shen

Buffed

His Q clears camps faster, so jungle Shen is a better pick.

  • Q monster damage modifier: 100/125/150/175/200 → 120/140/160/180/200

Thresh

Nerfed

Weaker auto-attacks and a softer ultimate, so his trades and fights deal less damage.

  • Attack damage: 56 → 54
  • R damage: 250/400/550 (+100% AP) → 200/350/500 (+100% AP)

Zaahen

Buffed

Lower early Q cooldown lets him trade and skirmish more often in lane.

  • Q cooldown: 10/9/8/7/6s → 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s

Items

Doran's Bow

Nerfed

A small damage cut so marksmen pick between Doran's Bow and Doran's Blade instead of always taking the Bow.

  • Attack damage: 8 → 7

Overlord's Bloodmail

Adjusted

More flat damage and less from the missing-health passive, a net buff for most juggernauts.

  • Attack damage: 30 → 40
  • Retribution: +0-12% total AD → +0-10% total AD (based on missing health)

Game modes and systems

Teamfight Tactics client

TFT moves to its own standalone client from November 4, with a button to swap between games, so this patch is a larger download than usual.

  • Existing TFT cosmetics stay usable in League
  • First TFT-only Little Legends: December 1
  • Full TFT cosmetic separation: December 15

ARAM: Mayhem

Some strong new augments were toned down, survivability augments got buffs, and two maps came back into rotation.

All 7 changes
  • Hecarim ability haste: 10 → 0
  • Take 'Em Down Down Down five-hit damage: (15 + 5% bonus AS + 0.15% total AH)% missing health → 17% missing health
  • Weapon of Destiny flat armor pen scalar: 35 → 20
  • Weapon of Destiny flat magic pen scalar: 25 → 15
  • Soul Eater health per stack: 20 → 30
  • Stay Resolute armor and MR per ability hit: 1/2/3 (levels 1/7/11) → 2/3 (levels 1/11)
  • Butcher's Bridge and Koeshin's Crossing: unavailable → enabled

Classic mode

The Classic event adds old versions of Volibear, Swain and Elise, and has its own balance changes that do not affect normal Summoner's Rift.

All 25 changes
  • New old-version champions: Volibear, Swain, Elise
  • Aatrox passive cooldown: 225 → 225/200/175/150
  • Amumu passive MR shred: 15/25/35 → 15/20/25
  • Amumu Q damage: 80/140/200/260/320 → 80/130/180/230/280
  • Amumu R cooldown: 150/130/110s → 170/145/120s
  • Evelynn Q base damage: 40/55/70/85/100 → 40/60/80/100/120
  • Ezreal W AP ratio: 60% → 80%
  • Ezreal W healing effectiveness: 50% → 70%
  • Ezreal E AP ratio: 75% → 80%
  • Fiddlesticks E damage per bounce: 65/85/105/125/145 → 50/75/100/125/150 (+45% AP)
  • Gangplank base health regen: 5 → 7
  • Gangplank health per level: 81 → 89
  • Gangplank passive max stacks: 3 → 4
  • Gangplank Q mana cost: 50/55/60/65/70 → 40/45/50/55/60
  • Gangplank R cooldown: 120/115/110s → 120/110/100s
  • Janna passive global move speed: 3% → 2%
  • Mordekaiser R pet bonus AD: 75% of target's AD → 75% of Mordekaiser's AD
  • Mordekaiser R bonus damage to inhibitors and Nexus: 75% → 0%
  • Nami Q damage: 75/130/185/240/295 (+65% AP) → 90/145/200/255/310 (+100% AP)
  • Nami W damage reduction per bounce: 30% → 15%
  • Olaf W bonus attack damage: 7/14/21/28/35 → 10/17/24/31/38
  • Olaf E cooldown: 9/8/7/6/5s → 8/7/6/5/4s
  • Rammus base armor: 28.8 → 25
  • Rammus attack damage per level: 3.5 → 2.75
  • Classic Pass token grants per game: +50% for the rest of Classic

Why it matters: a buff or nerf of a few points rarely changes how you play a champion, but it can change which champions are strong. Check this page each patch, then look at the tier list.
